note: Versioned pipeline registry (safe-versioning policy, docs/15). Select the active pipeline with ONE value (env PIPELINE_MODE overrides `active`), never by editing source. PRODUCTION = `composite-v1`: Higgsfield renders only the scene, the real source-CAD ring is composited in, so jewelry geometry is identical to source BY CONSTRUCTION (the AI can never redraw prongs, band width, head/gallery, or invent stones/gold/designs). Switched from `legacy` by explicit user instruction 2026-07-20 (permanent fix for recurring geometry/logo/cloth drift; see QUALITY_MEMORY.json#composite-v1-production-lock). ENGINE UNCHANGED: Higgsfield remains the sole generation engine (docs/21) - compositing preserved pixels is not generation (docs/21 §2). `legacy` (Higgsfield draws the ring too) is retained intact for experimentation but is NOT production. Neither version may be switched automatically in either direction - only by explicit user instruction. The preserved logo and premium-white cloth are ALSO enforced locally (print_logo_on_cloth.py / whiten_cloth.py) in production, never AI-drawn/graded.

policy.active_activation: composite-v1 IS PRODUCTION BY EXPLICIT USER INSTRUCTION 2026-07-20 (permanent-geometry-fix). This supersedes the 2026-07-16 restore-original-lifecycle instruction that had set legacy as production. Deliberate, user-ordered production baseline - not an automatic fallback. Automatic switching between versions remains forbidden in both directions; only an explicit user instruction may change `active`.

composite-v1.description: PRODUCTION (user-instructed 2026-07-20). Higgsfield renders only the scene; the real source-CAD ring is composited in - jewelry geometry identical to source by construction (prongs, band width, head/gallery, stone count/orientation can never be redrawn or invented). The preserved logo is composited locally (print_logo_on_cloth.py) and cloth is neutralised to premium white locally (whiten_cloth.py); neither is AI-drawn or AI-graded.

legacy.description: RETAINED, NOT PRODUCTION (user-instructed 2026-07-20). The original Higgsfield MCP lifecycle that generated the previously approved catalogs: Higgsfield renders the scene AND the jewelry from the approved prompts; the preserved logo is composited locally afterwards (docs/04 P0 - AI never renders the logo). Geometry is NOT guaranteed by construction here - the AI redraws the ring, which is the root cause of the recurring prong/band/head/invention drift; that is why production moved to composite-v1. Kept intact for manual experimentation only; never selected automatically, never a fallback.

terminology.Higgsfield: The only production image generation engine (docs/21) - unchanged by the 2026-07-20 switch. Higgsfield renders the scene in BOTH versions; compositing preserved pixels is not generation (docs/21 §2).
terminology.Composite-first: `composite-v1`. Higgsfield renders only the scene; the real source-CAD ring is composited in. THIS IS PRODUCTION (user-instructed 2026-07-20) - geometry identical by construction.
terminology.Logo compositing: NOT a pipeline. The preserved logo is composited locally in BOTH versions - required by docs/04 P0 in all cases and unaffected by this switch.
terminology.note: Both versions call Higgsfield. The distinction is whether Higgsfield draws the RING. Production = composite-v1 = the ring is real source pixels (never AI-drawn), so geometry cannot drift or be invented.
